title: Settings » Advanced Settings
text:
## Settings » Advanced Settings
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000047895
There are many Advanced Settings to configure the website for different specific tasks, and they are divided into 6 categories:
Global
URL Rules
Members
Sign Ups & Billing
Search
Text Editor
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183478775/original/kutDcfNAcv45NDBTv0Sn-8kwgOaPMoHGgQ.png?1786481768 | alt: ]
To find the advanced setting, admins can search for:
Name of the Setting
Description
System Variable
Default Value
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183479186/original/euQpvje-AU42JFD2zHT3Es_qBzzOMHJvVA.png?1786482189 | alt: ]
The System Variable and Default Values for each Advanced Setting are displayed below the setting description.

## 1. Global
This section outlines key configuration settings and optimizations available for enhancing the website's performance, security, design, and administrative experience. These settings are categorized into four primary sections:
Optimization
Security
Design
Admin
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183542224/original/73YjYx6uEFk3kvvPid9D4xcRnE01jLzR0A.png?1786568105 | alt: ]

## Optimization
This section outlines key website optimization and index settings aimed at improving site performance, user experience, and search engine visibility.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183479441/original/eSVnyKcdE9qgfuQzByZd11xMqarYQbYS6w.png?1786482531 | alt: ]
Meta Robots Setting. (index.follow enables search engines to crawl your site. no-index, no-follow disables all robots from crawling your website.
It improves website performance by optimizing the delivery of Google Maps JavaScript files. When enabled, the system only loads the required JavaScript files when a Google Maps feature or location autocomplete functionality is requested on a page.
This helps reduce unnecessary resource loading and can improve page load times, especially on pages where Google Maps functionality is not required.
If a widget interferes with this functionality, the system will identify  and highlight the widget causing the conflict:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12182155192/original/yiKaU46c72C6f_SVyRXQTNqMZY1_GlVurw.png?1784217867 | alt: ]
Use the built-in CDN URL to speed up the delivery of resources vs. the relative path of your domain name.
Section to enter a URL to use a service like imagekit.io to serve images from an image CDN with automatic optimization and real-time transformation.
Ampify is used to create an Accelerated Mobile Page (AMP) compliant version of your website. AMP-compliant websites are lightweight and designed to give mobile visitors a fast, smooth, and engaging experience.
When enabled (recommended), the frontend of the site will use updated versions of jQuery, jQuery UI, and Bootstrap JavaScript libraries.
If enabled, the first web page visited from a mobile device will display a brief loading message, which helps improve page speed metrics.
If ON, embedded iFrames will be lazy loaded, and the full iframe will be loaded when visitors scroll to it — improving PageSpeed scores. For embedded YouTube videos, only their thumbnail will load at first, and the full video only when visitors click to play.
When Lazyload iframe Embeds is enabled, this comma separated list of source domains will be targeted as iFrames to lazyload.
Automatically converts all user-uploaded images to WebP for better performance .

## Security
This section highlights important security settings designed to protect the website and its users.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183481290/original/KsdgR0lbm5WhbLQD57B74AmRhpRUvdRaYA.jpeg?1786484623 | alt: ]
This will protect the login page from being called from an iframe that is not on the same domain name.
This will enable the HTTP security headers and Content Security Policies. Over an HTTP connection, the website will add headers for Content Security Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options and X-XSS-Protection. Over an HTTPS connection, an additional header for Strict-Transport-Security is added.
Email Confirmation Expiration Time
Define how long new member signup confirmation links remain valid before they expire in seconds.

## Design
This section covers various configuration and localization settings for the website’s front-end experience.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183481335/original/lYyFQwOsd70q7jKXE3HMrMEZVcmb0-WfQA.png?1786484718 | alt: ]
Default top-level category image to display in geo-map.
This setting will disable all pluralized text labels throughout the website. If set to OFF (default), automatic pluralization of text labels surrounded by %% will be enabled.
This is the list of language options displayed in the Google Translate Dropdown Menu.
The Google Maps option to 'Fill in the location fields below based on where I move the marker on the map above' when members are entering the location for their profile will be hidden.
When set ON, it will disable Bootstrap and theme-styles CSS spreadsheets.
Will modify text if the language of the website should be read from the right side of the page to the left.
Section to add the latitude and longitude separated by a comma.
The default width of images added to Froala WYSIWYG editors throughout the website.

## Admin
This section controls the visibility of the built-in chatbot within the admin panel.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183482923/original/-zBIAKbuoGFyz5dmuRsNyVWBEs96PZx9EQ.png?1786486982 | alt: ]
When this is enabled, the BD chatbot will show up in the corner of specific pages in the admin.
Disable preview screenshots across admin sections. Select from: Dashboard, Web Page Builder, Edit Post Settings, Form Manager and Domain Manager .

## 2. URL Rules
This section outlines essential website configuration settings that govern how the site's URLs, member profile pages, dashboard, and publishing features are structured and managed. These settings are organized into the following categories:
Website
Member Profile Pages
Member Dashboard
Post Publishing
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183542231/original/hBTxYTB4KZqUkJ8eM11BhFdZJYgEWtiqYA.png?1786568134 | alt: ]

## Website
This section includes settings that control URL structure, canonical tags, page redirects, and iframe permissions for the website.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183484572/original/NfJmDbVAB0SshNtLhkrNliX8Zw5va_RwtA.png?1786489887 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183484575/original/8kiKx2jChWdnYkFFOEE__xz3avCT-Uzkhw.png?1786489898 | alt: ]
Select www to include www in the domain of the site, select non-www to exclude www from the domain. After changing this setting, please refresh the htaccess file to implement the change.
Option to select the Web Page visitors should be redirected to if the URL they requested does not exist.
All member search results pages that have more than one location type in the Canonical Tag will be reduced to the most localized version possible.
All member search results pages that have more than one category in the Canonical Tag (a main category and a sub-level category, for example) will be reduced to only contain the most specific category.
All member search results pages that have the country in the Canonical Tag will have the country removed.
Redirect members that are logged in and visit checkout pages to the user dashboard.
URL for the Categories Page. By default this is set to '/categories' to match the Web Page for Categories.
Member signup pages use the format /checkout/membership-plan-id by default. Edit the first portion of this URL (checkout) using this setting.
Files uploaded through "File Upload"; Form Fields are saved in the folder /uploads/curriculum-vitae/ by default.
A Setting to control over which domains can load content from their website in an iframe.
When enabled, member review and contact pages will use a noindex, follow robots meta tag to prevent these pages from being indexed by search engines.
When enabled, paginated search results pages, starting with page 2, will use a noindex, follow robots meta tag to prevent these pages from being indexed by search engines.
Set an alternate URL for the header logo. By default, the logo links to your website’s homepage. Enter a full URL (e.g., https://example.com) to replace this behavior and have the logo link to a different page or external website. Leave blank to keep the default.

## Member Profile Pages
This section focuses on configuring the structure and format of member profile page URLs.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183484586/original/Luvs-j18SVPPAATEI7_bxq4tqw7kmiS7ug.png?1786489934 | alt: ]
Elements to create a template that will be used when generating a member's profile page URL. Member_Name is required; however, you can include or exclude all other elements.
The URL used for writing a member review.
Choose "First Name First" (default) to display member names in profile page URLs as first_name-last_name. Choose "Last Name First" to display member names in profile page URLs as last_name-first_name.

## Member Dashboard
This section defines the URL structures used across various areas of the Member Dashboard and member-related features.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183484598/original/LtACIuFN1z5YLcmpeEyFzD-ksRJV9GeTzQ.png?1786489980 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183484601/original/lRhZMx3GnFnr7-CBZgbXvS-_1S4VcKlNrQ.png?1786489994 | alt: ]
Structure used for posts when created or saved.
The root URL of the Member Dashboard that will display when a member is logged in to their account.
The portion URL of the Member Dashboard that will display when a member is creating a Post.
This is added to member profile page URLs to create the full URL where a Lead or Private Message can be submitted directly to a member.
The portion URL of the Member Dashboard that will display when a member is cloning a Post.
The portion URL of the Member Dashboard that will display when a member is creating a Multi-Photo Post Type.
The portion URL of the Member Dashboard that will display when a member is arranging the photos of a Multi-Photo Post.
The portion URL of the Member Dashboard that will display when a member is adding photos to a Multi-Photo Post Type for first time.
A portion of the URL used when a member fills out the "About" form in the Member Dashboard.
A portion of the URL used when a member fills out the "Contact Details" form in the Member Dashboard.
The portion URL of the Member Dashboard that will display when a member is on their Member Dashboard Home Page.
The portion of the Member Dashboard URL used for the Update Password page.
The portion of the Member Dashboard URL used when a member views their account billing information.
The portion of the Member Dashboard URL used for the Manage Account page.
Business Toolkit URL in the Member Dashboard.
URL slug for the Sub Accounts / Additional Locations account area page. Leave blank or set to "additional_locations" to preserve the default.

## Post Publishing
This section outlines the URL structure settings related to member interactions, dashboard navigation, and key user actions on the website.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183484661/original/fTmH7ScZ6d6B0NEFgl4qQ8veRhCvsRsGLw.png?1786490057 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183484664/original/TQtuuMSlx6kATBs-hFE1DyPnvXTtWDMXQQ.png?1786490065 | alt: ]
The URL to use for member searches.
If this is set to 1, when members create a post in one of the member features, the location information of the member will not be included in the URL structure of the post.  If set to 0, the site will attempt to add the location information of the member to the URL structure of the post.
The URL used for the member password retrieval functionality on the frontend of the website.
Portion of the URL that will display when a member is verifying their account in the Member Dashboard.
The portion of the URL of the Member Dashboard that will display when a member is viewing their Leads page in their Account.
The portion of the URL of the Member Review that will display when visiting the member reviews details page.
The portion URL of the Member Dashboard that will display when a member is editing a Post.
The portion URL of the Member Dashboard that will display when a member is deleting a Post.
The portion URL of the Member Dashboard that will display when a member is editing a Multi-Photo Post Type.
The portion URL of the Member Dashboard that will display when a member is uploading photos to a Multi-Photo Post Types.
The portion URL of the Member Dashboard that will display when a member is deleting a Mutli-Photo Post Type.
The portion URL of the Member Dashboard that will display when a member is saving a Post.
The portion URL of the Member Dashboard that will display when a member is viewing their Post.
The portion URL of the Member Dashboard that will display when a member is editing the photos data in a Multi-Photo Post Type.
The URL used for the newsletter unsubscribe page.
A portion of the URL used when a member fills out the ''Listing Details'' form in the Member Dashboard.
A  portion of the URL used when a member uploads their Profile Photo, Logo, and/or Cover Photo in the Member Dashboard.
A portion of the URL used when a member selects Service Areas in the Member Dashboard.
The URL used for the homepage of the website.
The portion of the Member Dashboard URL used when a member upgrades their account.

## 3. Members
This section details various display, permission, security, and notification settings that help customize how member profiles function, how users interact with the platform, and how data is handled. These settings include:
Display
Permissions
Security
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183542301/original/c-XNhqH0X1pumQw2uMvNhE2IpmyE_MH9lQ.png?1786568168 | alt: ]

## Display
This section includes settings that control the display and behavior of member profile images and category visibility.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183485479/original/Pkezuz3V5iKk-3quX6VCDxuJnw1HCxrTRQ.png?1786491473 | alt: ]
If the member does not have a profile photo, will use the member's logo as profile photo - and vice versa.
The system will first attempt to use a member's profile cover photo as the social share image.
The system will show the sub and sub-sub level categories under ''Specialties''.
The Top Level Category that displays in the header of member profile pages will be hidden.
Set to ON (default) to not warn members when they upload a profile photo or logo that will have to be stretched in order to work when shared on social media websites. Set to OFF to warn members when uploading a small image that will have to be stretched.

## Permissions
This section covers various member management and listing features designed to enhance control, security, and user interaction.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183485924/original/W-BjHb-YqROtvFEXvb0yyJ3OCuru_3r6yA.png?1786492246 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183485925/original/0OAFWprURP7F_TtxraFWwwYcTmq3ZgLv-A.png?1786492257 | alt: ]
If enabled, members can use the built in promotion tools.
If enabled and set to 1, members will not be able to send messages to themselves from their own profile pages.
Enable to allow members to view their invoices and perform all or limited actions.
Members will be allowed to include additional links in their ABOUT ME section.  This setting is only available for the Bootstrap Version of the software using the default "Bootstrap Theme - Member Profile - Overview Tab" widget.
Members will be allowed to post live links in the Quote section of their profile pages. This setting is only available for the Bootstrap Version of the software using the default 'Bootstrap Theme - Member Profile - Overview Tab' widget.
If the setting is "ON", it will remove any HTML tag for the input fields in the Listing Details Form.
Prevent members from submitting reviews to their own profile page.
Phone country codes for the Country Code + Phone number form field type.
The status of Sub Accounts (Active, On Hold, Past Due, etc) will automatically update to match that of their parent account.

## Security
This section addresses key security and privacy settings related to member consent, login behavior, and session management.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183486017/original/m2fbtQF27j1rXwpHxHb9wBliZMi8RGUBZQ.png?1786492369 | alt: ]
Set this to 1 if members who have already provided consent to store their data must re-consent when taking a new action (upgrading or updating credit card info).  Set to 0 (default) if members who have already provided consent should not be shown the consent checkboxes again.
When set to OFF, these links will require members to log in to their account before they can view the linked page. When set to ON, members will be automatically logged in to their account when clicking on these links.
Enter the number of minutes (without commas) a session will stay active for a member when they are logged into the website.
When a chat message is submitted, the system will automatically check for spam and block messages that violate the rules.
When enabled, this setting includes the member login token in outgoing webhook payloads for member-related events, including new member registrations, member additions, updates, deletions, and member self-service form submissions. This setting is disabled by default for security purposes. The account password hash and cookies are never included in webhook payloads, even when this setting is enabled.

## 4. Sign Ups and Billing
This section covers settings related to Member Sign-Up and Login, Account Status, Billing, and Notifications, offering tools to customize and streamline user account management and payment processes. These settings include:
Member Sign Up / Login
Member Account Status
Billing
Notifications
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183542332/original/PIJvJQ07ORVVuw-zU3GrGlY2mcMzUwNCpg.png?1786568216 | alt: ]

## Member Sign Up / Login
This section outlines various member account and registration settings that enhance user experience and site functionality.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183539225/original/fcUMp9Cdph7qGJodZGRa1E7x3jxwaXA0Ng.png?1786564816 | alt: ]
If a member does not have a first name defined, this value will be placed where the first name would be in email templates.
Displays inactive countries in drop-down menus around the website, including payment pages
Members can have multiple accounts with the same email address (but they need different passwords).
Enter a comma separated list of pages (/login,/about,etc) where if a member logs in from those pages, they will always be redirected to the page defined in their membership level setting.
The minimum number of seconds it should take to submit member signup forms once the page loads.
The user will remain on the same page after they sign up as a member via the Express Member Registration form instead of being redirected to the Member Dashboard.
A comma-separated list of pages that will continue to redirect users to the Member Dashboard after they have signed up via the Express Member Registration form, even if the ''Reload Same Web Page After Express Member Registration'' Advanced Setting is enabled.
When enabled, the member account Upgrade page (/account/upgrade) displays available membership plans as a modern card-based layout instead of the classic stacked list.

## Member Account Status
This section manages member account statuses related to cancellations and payments.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183539418/original/-9_nbTmx3AkxrrJy1DKoCRIqQZqzZD9MRA.png?1786564960 | alt: ]
Choose which status you would like to assign to members once they have requested to cancel their account.
When set to ON, members with a past due invoice will automatically have their account status changed to Past Due during the site's daily billing process, even if they do not log in. If a member logs in or appears in the Search Members page in the Admin before the daily process runs, their status will be updated to Past Due at that time instead.

## Billing
This section covers advanced billing and member management features, including sales representative tracking, AVS address validation for payments, and invoice payment instructions.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183540166/original/kQbd_0-tX9kniT0OWKhfJ4SlJavtPDFapQ.png?1786565835 | alt: ]
Turn on this feature if you want to enable sales_rep tracking for your members.
When this is enabled, all forms that collect credit card information will also include fields necessary for AVS validation by your payment gateway. When you disable this, make sure all AVS settings in your active payment gateway are off.
Enter the address and payment information that will appear in the Pay to box on your invoices to your members.
Enable this setting to allow the website's Stripe account based in India to accept payments from other countries.
Set to Yes to save the Billing Address entered during signup as the member's profile address as well.  Set to No (default) to only save the Billing Address as billing information and not as their profile address.
Turn this setting ON to enable the credit system. Turn this setting OFF to disable showing the credit system functionality and auto-applying of credits to your members. You must also have the Member Credit System Add-on active for this setting to work.
Only works when the “Member Credits System” Add-On is enabled and the "Enable Credits System" Advanced Setting is set to "ON". Set to ON in order to enable prorated calculation when members change their own plans.
Only works with “MEMBER CREDITS SYSTEM” add-on.. Set to ON to deduct the first day's usage from the proration amount calculation.
Select the types of transactions where member credits can be applied. If an item is unchecked, member credits will not be used for those types of transactions.

## Notifications
This section focuses on email notification settings related to member billing and account status changes.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183540182/original/6Oimt2qCMjqVkNJzOKUI4cJzvTpdFurO7w.png?1786565868 | alt: ]
When a member updates their credit card or billing information in the new billing module, send a notification to the email addresses specified here.
When set to OFF (default), the Default Website Email Address will receive an email notification when a member requests to cancel their accounts.  When set to ON, no notification email will be sent when a member requests to cancel their account.
Set this to ON to send an email notification to the Default Website Email address when a user's attempt to sign up for a paid Membership Plan fails.
When this is set to ON, the system will not send a Daily Invoice Report to the admin when there is no billing activity.

## 5. Search
This section focuses on Display Settings, Search Modules, and Search Logic; key areas that shape how users interact with and experience search results on the website. These settings consist of:
Display
Search Modules
Search Logic
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183542376/original/jdTdtEA7j7jgJjMgykXrQ7VyiJNsZuAXcQ.png?1786568262 | alt: ]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183542374/original/yC8Z34QasqXSUSjMW55hHE6bdoPUsfVUoQ.png?1786568252 | alt: ]

## Display
This section focuses on enhancing location-based search and URL functionality.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183540327/original/X3LKZAzqjETJ3mRXm9As0rqv5L9jpg-kVQ.png?1786566021 | alt: ]
Enter a comma-separated list of Country Codes that should link to a list of cities in the country instead of states/provinces on the /locations page of the site.
If turned on the member's position will show on member search result pages.
Set to OFF (default) to show members that match a ''Pretty URL'' search results page's location by text only (do fewer Google Maps API calls). Set to ON to include all member location search results features (do more Google Maps API calls).
Enter the Google Maps API Key for the 'Enable All Location Features For ''Pretty URL'' Search Results Pages' functionality.
When set to OFF (default), visitors to the site can share their location by clicking on the icon in the website's location search fields.  When set to ON, prompt all visitors to share their location automatically as soon as they visit the website.
Select how more search results are fetched with the ''Load More Results'' button.

## Search Modules
This section offers settings to customize how categories and filters behave in member search results.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183540345/original/qzMoyTFcD92Zn0iBcj6oTJuDYWqdjUqaRQ.png?1786566041 | alt: ]
If enabled, auto-expands the next drop-down menu in a chained search series.
If enabled, the next drop-down in a chained search series will be optional rather than pre-selecting the first option.
Will display member's sub-level categories on member search result pages. NOTE - will slow down load time.
It will load all the accordions on the dynamic category sidebar modules open.
If turned on the member's top level category will show on member search result pages.
Set to ON (default) to return members listed in ANY of the selected categories. Set to OFF to only return members listed in ALL of the selected categories.
When clicking on dynamic filters checkboxes, keep the top or sub category context from the URL so the dynamic filters in sidebar only show categories related to the page the category filter widget is being displayed on.

## Search Logic
This section defines how location-based searches are conducted for different administrative levels, such as neighborhoods, counties, and states, allowing results to be returned based on either geographical bounds or a specified radius.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183540364/original/Pi-9ME7OVsaBKCilH1ypNJj0zApxS9GJ3g.png?1786566069 | alt: ]
Select how results will be returned when a user searches for a "Neighborhood" location (typically a section of a city in many countries). Selecting "Bounds" will return results that are within the bounds of the searched location.  Selecting ''Radius'' (default) will will return results within the ''Default Search Radius'' of the center of the searched location.
This setting needs the ''Members Search Engine'' setting to be set to 1 to work. With this setting, you can choose the type of search that will be performed when a location is an Administrative Area Level 2 or has the same location scope as an Administrative Area Level 2. The two options that it has are ''bounds'' (default) or ''radius''. if set to radius, the radius that will be applied will be the one on the setting ''Default Radius Search".
Select how results will be returned when a user searches for an ''Administrative Area Level 2'' location (typically a ''county'' in many countries). Selecting ''Bounds'' (default) will return results that are within the bounds of the searched location.  Selecting ''Radius'' will will return results within the ''Default Search Radius'' of the center of the searched location.
Select how results will be returned when a user searches for an ''Administrative Area Level 1'' location (typically a state or province). Selecting ''Bounds'' (default) will return results that are within the bounds of the searched location.  Selecting ''Radius'' will will return results within the ''Default Search Radius'' of the center of the searched location.
Enter a comma-separated list of the custom field variable names to exclude when performing a keyword search.
Enter a comma-separated list of the custom member fields to exclude when performing a keyword search.
Enter a comma-separated list of the default member fields to exclude when performing a keyword search.
A comma-separated list [NO SPACES] of the Member Profile Fields that must be filled in by a member for their profile to be considered "COMPLETE". If the "Require Complete Profiles" setting is enabled, a member will not appear in search results unless their profile is "COMPLETE".

## 6. Text Editor
This section outlines settings related to Text Editors, Permissions, and File Upload capabilities on the website. These options help manage how users create and format content, what types of HTML and media are permitted, and the size limits for uploads.
Text Editors
Permissions
File Upload
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183542423/original/qS4JzfS9rFEAmaOawzB-AWNbNXCSTjjm5A.png?1786568301 | alt: ]

## Text Editors
This section covers advanced settings for the Froala WYSIWYG text editor, including options to simplify pasted content to plain text, enable emojis, embed widget shortcodes, and integrate third-party tools like Embedly and ChatGPT.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12183540397/original/-6LvsLOTXrAfLtkgteAvJ-yK028eVtcsuA.png?1786566114 | alt: ]
When this setting is enabled, Froala WYSIWYG HTML Editor filters the pasted content and keeps only plain text by removing all its rich formatting.
Enable Emojis in Froala's toolbar.
The text editor "Froala Text Editor - Media Manager Access" will allow embedding widget shortcode in the text editor and rendering the widget's HTML on the front-end of the website.
